ai.literal: Intimacy, that which is called, what if asked: in any way privilege not-rejecting friendship.
ai.translation: If asked what is called true intimacy, it is the friendship that never rejects the liberties taken by a friend.
ai.modern: பழைமை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எது என்றால், நண்பர்கள் உரிமை எடுத்துக்கொள்வதை எந்த வகையிலும் தடுக்காத நட்பே ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essence of long-standing friendship, termed here as intimacy. It asks what constitutes such a bond, and answers that it is a friendship that never rejects or resents the liberties taken by the friend. The word 'கீழ்ந்திடா' literally means not tearing or breaking, illustrating that true friends do not let the exercise of familiar privileges damage their relationship.

ai.literal: To friendship, the essential part is the right of intimacy; and to that, becoming agreeable is the noble ones' duty.
ai.translation: The defining feature of true friendship is the freedom to take liberties. It is the duty of the noble to gracefully accept such intimacy.
ai.modern: நட்பின் முக்கிய உறுப்பு, நண்பர்கள் தமக்குள் உரிமை எடுத்துக்கொள்வதாகும். அந்த உரிமைக்கு இனிமையாக உடன்பட்டு நடப்பது சிறந்தவர்களின் கடமையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core of long-standing friendship as 'கெழுதகைமை', which is the right to take liberties without hesitation. The word 'உறுப்பு' compares this right to an essential limb, showing that friendship cannot function without it. Furthermore, the word 'உப்பு' (literally salt) is used metaphorically to mean being agreeable or adding a pleasant taste. Therefore, it is the duty of noble people to warmly accept and be agreeable to the liberties taken by their old friends.

ai.literal: familiar friendship what will do intimacy having done in that way not accepting if
ai.translation: What is the use of a long-standing friendship if one does not accept the liberties taken by a friend?
ai.modern: நண்பர்கள் உரிமையோடு செய்யும் செயல்களை அப்படியே ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளாவிட்டால் நெடுங்காலமாகப் பழகிய நட்பினால் என்ன பயன்?
ai.explanation: This couplet questions the value of an old friendship if friends cannot tolerate the liberties taken by each other. The phrase kezhutakaimai refers to the intimate right to act freely without asking permission. If a friend acts with such intimacy and the other does not accept it gracefully, the long-standing bond loses its meaning. True friendship requires embracing the actions done out of deep familiarity.

ai.translation: If friends do something without asking out of intimacy, true friends will gladly accept it with a loving heart.

ai.explanation: This couplet explains how true friends react when their companions take liberties. If a friend does something on their behalf without asking for permission, relying on their close intimacy, the other will not be offended. Instead, they will gladly accept and appreciate the action because of their deeply loving nature. The word 'கெழுதகை' highlights the rightful familiarity that true friendship grants.

ai.literal: Ignorance or great intimacy, thus let one understand, painful things friends if do.
ai.translation: If friends do things that cause you pain, understand it as either their innocent ignorance or the privilege of great intimacy.
ai.modern: நண்பர்கள் மனம் வருந்தத்தக்க செயல்களைச் செய்தால், அதனை அவர்களின் அறியாமை என்றோ அல்லது மிகுந்த உரிமையின் பாற்பட்டது என்றோ உணர்ந்துகொள்ள வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet advises on how to handle hurtful actions from close friends. When friends do something that causes pain, one should not immediately become angry or break the friendship. Instead, one should attribute the action either to their innocent ignorance or to the deep intimacy that makes them feel entitled to act freely. By understanding it this way, the bond of friendship is preserved.

ai.literal: At the limit those who stood will not abandon, even at the place of ruin, the connection of those who stood in antiquity.
ai.translation: Those who stand firmly within the bounds of noble character will not abandon their bond with old friends, even in times of ruin.
ai.modern: நற்பண்பின் எல்லையில் நிலைத்து நிற்பவர்கள், தம் பழைய நண்பர்கள் அழிவைச் சந்தித்த காலத்திலும், அவர்களுடனான நட்பைக் கைவிட மாட்டார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the unwavering loyalty of true friends. The phrase 'எல்லைக்கண் நின்றார்' refers to those who stand firmly within the boundaries of noble character. It states that such people will never abandon the connection ('தொடர்பு') with their long-standing friends ('தொல்லைக்கண் நின்றார்'), even when faced with ruin or severe loss ('தொலைவிடத்தும்'). The word 'தொலைவு' here is taken to mean ruin or hardship, emphasizing that true intimacy withstands the greatest trials.

ai.literal: Ruin-bringing even if do, love will not sever, of love path-came friendship they.
ai.translation: Even if their friends do things that bring them ruin, those bound by a long-standing friendship rooted in love will not sever their affection.
ai.modern: நண்பர்கள் தமக்கு அழிவு தரும் செயல்களைச் செய்தாலும், அன்பின் வழியில் வந்த பழைய நட்பினை உடையவர்கள் அவர்கள் மீதான அன்பை விடமாட்டார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the resilience of true, long-standing friendship. The phrase 'friendship that has come along the path of love' describes a deep bond built over time. Even if such friends commit acts that cause harm or ruin, the injured party will not break the bond. The word for 'will not sever' emphasizes that genuine intimacy forgives even severe mistakes and maintains its affection.

ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme tolerance found in true, long-standing friendships. The word 'நாள்' (day) is used here to mean a truly worthwhile or good day. When friends make a mistake, those who possess the deep intimacy ('கெழுதகைமை') to ignore it without questioning do not feel anger. Instead, they consider it a good day, as it gives them an opportunity to exercise and prove the strength of their unconditional friendship.

ai.literal: Unbroken lineage-came friends' friendship those who do not forsake desires the world.
ai.translation: The world will cherish those who never forsake their bond with friends of an unbroken, long-standing lineage.
ai.modern: தலைமுறை தலைமுறையாகத் தொடர்ந்து வரும் பழைய நண்பர்களின் நட்பைக் கைவிடாமல் காப்பவர்களை இந்த உலகம் விரும்பிப் போற்றும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the value of maintaining long-standing, ancestral friendships. The phrase 'keṭāa vaḻivanta' refers to a relationship that has come down through generations without breaking. 'Kēṇmaiyār' denotes friends who share such an enduring bond. The world greatly admires and desires the company of those who refuse to let go of such deep-rooted ties. By preserving old friendships, a person earns the respect and affection of society.

ai.translation: Those who never depart from their good nature towards old friends will be desired even by their enemies.

ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of unwavering loyalty to old friends. The phrase 'தலைப்பிரியாதார்' refers to those who never abandon their good nature ('பண்பு') when dealing with long-standing companions. Such steadfast character is so admirable that even 'விழையார்'—those who do not naturally like them, such as enemies—will be drawn to desire their friendship.
